config.note: DEFAULT ILLUSTRATIVE config — gating on it requires re-validation; alternate configs are a re-run of the annotator

combo-ffffffffff.kept_pct_denominators: tau_curve.kept_pct / kept_pct_at: n_kept over n_scored (trades carrying an out-of-fold p_win); abstain.kept_pct: kept_trades over ALL extracted trades (unscored trades included); every kept_pct is a RAW 0-1 fraction, never a 0-100 percent (the cpcv_pass_pct raw-fraction artifact convention - scaled to percent only at display).

vix_band_winners_p10_p90.note: label-conditional and in-sample: the [p10, p90] band of THIS combo's WINNING trades' entry VIX (the aggs vix_band_lo/hi) — descriptive only, never a held-out estimate and never a default gate; an explicit config adopting a band requires its own validation.

notes: annotation-only: nothing is gated, filtered or re-ranked anywhere; a gating flip requires its own DEC + operator ruling and re-validation of the gated stream as its OWN strategy (MIN_TRADES=30 floor + DSR effective-N shrink with fewer trades).
p_win is strictly out-of-fold (CPCV purge+embargo, label_span/embargo = one conservative trade-index maximum-overlap value — an approximation that over-purges, never leaks).
expect near-random precision curves for most strategies: tau=0.8 keeps ~10-25% of trades ONLY under genuine skill — a flat curve is the honest common outcome, not a defect.
the tau sweep is a 10-way selection over the same trades: a future gating DEC must fold n_thresholds_swept into its DSR trial count (anti-double-dipping).
VIX stays REFERENCE-ONLY: this annotation READS the stored vix_entry stamps, never adds VIX to the 60-bit vocabulary; gating on VIX would make it load-bearing — a recorded operator collision point.

the DEFAULT abstain config carries NO VIX band: the stamped aggs vix_band_lo/hi is the p10-p90 of this combo's WINNING trades' entry VIX — label-conditional and in-sample (fit-on-self), recorded only as the informational vix_band_winners_p10_p90 field; a VIX gate exists only under an explicit operator config.
training reuses cascade-validated trades under the OOF discipline only (the disclosed double-dip boundary).
re-annotation over unchanged sidecars is byte-identical on the SAME box only: real-fit p_win floats are numpy/BLAS/libm-dependent, so cross-box float bits may differ (expected, disclosed).
